about.title: About
about.techFooter: Bachelor Thesis · Bern University of Applied Sciences · 2026
about.s1Body: This comparison portal was developed as part of a Bachelor Thesis at the Bern University of Applied Sciences (BFH). The aim is to support parents and students in finding the right Gymnasium preparation course in the Canton of Zurich.
about.s2Body: The portal uses a weighted utility analysis (Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis). Users can define which criteria are particularly important to them — for example price, quality, flexibility or location. Based on these weightings, the providers are evaluated and ranked by total score.
about.s3Body: Course data is automatically collected via web scraping from the providers' websites and regularly updated. An AI-based self-healing mechanism detects structural changes on provider websites and automatically adjusts the scrapers. All prices serve as orientation — the current information on the respective provider websites is always authoritative.
about.s4Body: This work was created in the Business Informatics programme at the Bern University of Applied Sciences (BFH), Department of Business.

zap.title: ZAP Info
zap.subtitle: Central Entrance Examination (ZAP) — Canton Zurich. Dates and information directly from official sources (zh.ch).
zap.whatBody: The Central Entrance Examination (ZAP) is the examination for entry into a secondary or vocational baccalaureate school in the Canton of Zurich. It is held annually in March and tests knowledge of mathematics and German.
zap.longBody: 6 years · entry after 6th grade primary school
zap.shortBody: 4 years · entry after 2nd or 3rd grade secondary school
zap.datesSubtitle: Data verified from official sources of the Canton of Zurich (zh.ch).
zap.disclaimer: This data is manually verified from official sources (zh.ch). The official information of the Canton of Zurich is always authoritative. A fully automated update via web scraping is defined as future work in the roadmap.
